stage: P2-50 one-ball common-throat to sill Z285, R125 with continuous rails
purpose: Final geometry diagnostic after R2 removed the sharp-transition impact but exposed gaps in the simulated side rails. Thresholds and 3x3 matrix remain unchanged.

criteria.name: sill_reached
criteria.rule: ball base frame x <= 0.110 m, z >= 0.305 m and |y| <= 0.020 m

criteria.name: sill_speed
criteria.rule: ball centre speed at sill >= 0.30 m/s

criteria.name: transition_bounce_gap
criteria.rule: maximum ball-bottom airborne gap above ramp in X=245..352 mm <= 20 mm

criteria.name: throat_lateral_containment
criteria.rule: maximum |y| from X=325 mm to sill <= 40 mm

criteria.name: d5065_contact_current
criteria.rule: absolute current during ball-wheel contact <= 20 A per motor

criteria.name: d5065_contact_torque
criteria.rule: absolute torque during ball-wheel contact <= 0.62 N m per motor

criteria.name: forbidden_launcher_contact_count
criteria.rule: no moving launcher contact with chassis, arch, LiDAR or ground

criteria.name: finite_state
criteria.rule: no NaN or Inf in telemetry

diagnostics_only: DART contact forces are uncalibrated and are not structural claims
single repeat per condition is a quick geometry gate, not a reliability estimate
absolute basket capacity and ball-ball behaviour are outside P2-50
